data.name: Aziyat
data.gender_notes: Aziyat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'aziza', meaning 'helper' or 'supporter'. The name Aziyat signifies someone who provides assistance and support to others. The name Aziyat carries the meaning “Helper, supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aziyat usually hope their child will grow to embody helper, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine grace and beauty of Allah.
data.etymology: Aziyat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helper, supporter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aziyat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: عزيت
in_arabic.meaning: تعني الاسم عزيت وهي تعبير عن القوة و العزة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عزيت مشتق من الجذر العربي (ع ز ي) الذي يحمل معاني القوة و العزة و الرفعة. ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات، منها قوله تعالى: "وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزُّ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ" (سورة المنافقون: 8). يستخدم الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية لتعبر عن القوة و العزة و المكانة الرفيعة.

in_urdu.name: عزیت
in_urdu.meaning: عزیت نام کا مطلب ہے قوت، عزت و اقتدار
in_urdu.long_meaning: عزیت نام عربی زبان کے اسکے معنی ہیں قوت، عزت و اقتدار کا اظہار. عربی جڑ (ع ز ي) سے نکلا ہے، جو قرآن کریم میں بھی ذکر ہوا ہے، جیسے: "وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزُّ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ" (المنافقون: 8). جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام عزت، وقار اور اعلیٰ مقام کی علامت ہے.

in_hindi.name: अज़ियत
in_hindi.meaning: अज़ियत नाम का अर्थ है शक्ति, सम्मान और प्रतिष्ठा
in_hindi.long_meaning: अज़ियत नाम की उत्पत्ति العربية जड़ (ع ز ي) से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है शक्ति, सम्मान और प्रतिष्ठा। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम उच्च दर्जा, गरिमा और ताकत का प्रतीक है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम बच्चे के लिए आशीर्वाद और उच्च भविष्य की कामना के साथ दिया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عزيت
in_pashto.meaning: عزيت د قوت، عزت او لوړوالی معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: عزيت نوم د عربي (ع ز ي) جذر څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د قوت، عزت او لوړوالی مانا لري. په قرآن کریم کې، الله فرمايي: "وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزُّ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ" (المنافقون: 8). د افغان او پښتنو په دود، دا نوم د عزت، وقار او لوړ مقام ښکارندوی دی.

in_english.name: Aziyat
in_english.meaning: Aziyat means strength, dignity, and high esteem in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aziyat originates from the Arabic root (ع ز ي), signifying strength, dignity, and high esteem. Referenced in the Quran (Al-Munafiqun: 8), "وَلِلَّهِ الْعِزُّ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ", it embodies spiritual significance and high status in Islamic tradition. The name reflects desirable personality traits such as resilience, honor, and leadership across Muslim cultures.

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل: عزیت (ah-zee-yat)
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: عزيت (ah-zee-yat)

data.cultural_impact: The name Aziyat emphasizes the importance of community and cooperation in Islamic culture. In a society where helping and supporting one another is a key value, the name Aziyat can be a source of pride for those who carry it.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Aziyat lies in its reminder of Allah's love and mercy. As Allah is the greatest helper and supporter (Al-Musawwir, Al-Qudus, Al-Wahhab), those who carry the name Aziyat are reminded to strive to be like Allah, and provide help and support to those in need. This can lead to a deeper connection with Allah, as helping others is considered an act of worship.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Aziyat signifies one who is exalted, noble, and elevated in status. It is a reminder of the infinite beauty and worth of the believer in the eyes of Allah, inspiring a deep sense of humility and gratitude.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: In the year 632 CE, during the early Islamic period, the region of Yemen was under the control of the Sassanid Empire. A powerful Arab tribe, the Banu Hanifa, rebelled against the Sassanid rule and established an independent state in central Arabia. They named their new state 'Aziyat', which means 'powerful' or 'mighty'. This name reflected the tribe's strength and determination.
historical_references.context: Early Islamic period, establishment of an independent Arab state in central Arabia

historical_references.reference: During the late Abbasid Caliphate, around 1250 CE, the city of Azerbaijan in present-day Iran was an important center of Islamic learning and culture. It was famous for its madrasas (religious schools) and scholars who were renowned for their knowledge in various fields, including philosophy, mathematics, and theology. The city was also known as 'Aziyat al-Mulk', which means 'the sublime sovereignty', reflecting its status as a center of Islamic power and influence.
historical_references.context: Late Abbasid Caliphate, important center of Islamic learning and culture

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Aziyat' is derived from Arabic language and holds a significant place in Islamic history and culture. In recent times, 'Aziyat' has gained popularity beyond its traditional context and is being used in various modern settings. The name is increasingly being associated with Islamic art revival, Middle Eastern fashion, and spiritual wellness. On social media platforms like Instagram and Pinterest, there is a growing trend of posting and sharing images of Islamic art, calligraphy, and geometric designs using the hashtag #Aziyat. On Etsy, there are numerous listings for handmade items such as wall art, clothing, and home decor that incorporate 'Aziyat' designs. The name embodies a sense of elegance, tradition, and spirituality, making it a popular choice for those seeking to add a touch of Middle Eastern influence to their homes or wardrobes.
